start: Settings, Health apps: the Health Connect row is Off, with a Connect button

user_sees: Health Connect's own permission screen for MettleUp
must_not: Workouts sent before the member allows it
The app closing

steps.action: Allow workouts (and calories) in Health Connect, come back to MettleUp
user_sees: Caption 'On. Each workout you finish goes to Health Connect as strength training, with its calories (an estimate), so Google Health and Samsung Health can show it.'
A 'Stop' button on the row
must_not: The row still says Off after access was given
Calories shown as exact rather than an estimate

user_sees: The workout shows in Google Health or Samsung Health as strength training
A line saying when workouts last went to Health Connect
must_not: The same workout in Health Connect twice
A workout on demo data sent

start: Health Connect is On; workouts were logged before it was switched on

user_sees: A question first: how many workouts, from when to when, and where they go, with a confirm button and 'Not now'
must_not: Anything sent before the member says yes
Workouts from before MettleUp's first run counted in without saying so

user_sees: The button counts up while sending
A result line with how many were sent
must_not: A second tap starting a second send
A success line when some were refused

steps.action: If older workouts were left out, tap 'Send older workouts too' and confirm
user_sees: A question that says they may show twice
Those workouts sent after the yes
must_not: Older workouts sent without the warning

start: A workout already sent to Health Connect (sending On, or later Stopped)

user_sees: The workout gone from MettleUp's history
must_not: The deleted workout still showing in Google Health or Samsung Health while MettleUp may still manage it

user_sees: The workout no longer listed
must_not: A different workout removed
An error shown to the member for a refused removal

start: Settings, Health apps on a phone where access is refused or Health Connect is missing

user_sees: 'Nothing opened? Open Health Connect, find MettleUp and allow it there.'
An 'Open Health Connect' button
must_not: A Connect button that does nothing with no word
The row saying On

steps.action: On a phone without Health Connect, open the page
user_sees: 'Health Connect is not available on this phone.' or 'Install or update Health Connect from the Play Store first.'
must_not: A crash or a blank row

steps.action: Tap 'Open Health Connect' when it cannot open
user_sees: A line saying where to find Health Connect instead
must_not: Nothing happening with no word

start: Health Connect On, with some refused workouts owed

user_sees: 'Sending…' then a result line
must_not: Owed workouts sent while sending is off

user_sees: 'Stopped. New workouts will not go to Health Connect. Workouts already sent stay there. To remove them, open Health Connect.'
A 'Turn on' button and 'Open Health Connect'
must_not: The next finished workout still sent
Owed workouts sent later by themselves

steps.action: Tap 'Turn on', then finish a workout
user_sees: Caption back to On; the new workout sent
must_not: Workouts finished while stopped sent without asking

start: Health Connect On, other health apps installed

steps.action: Finish a workout and open Google Health or Samsung Health
user_sees: The workout as strength training with estimated calories, nothing else
must_not: Sets, weights, notes, body weight or photos sent to Health Connect
A workout on demo data sent

user_sees: Plain words that only workouts logged in MettleUp are sent, and that workouts already sent stay in Health Connect after Stop
must_not: A promise that Stop removes what was sent
